  "overall_experience": "The Business Development Manager found Freshsales to be a generally effective tool for managing their team's sales tasks and activities. While it provided good visibility and streamlined delegation, there was a desire for more advanced reporting capabilities to gain deeper insights into team performance and pipeline health. While it provided good visibility and streamlined delegation, there was a desire for more advanced reporting capabilities to gain deeper insights into team performance and pipeline health.
